card.name: Small linking words before a following noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "and", "in" or a pronoun, right after a name or noun joined by "and" or in a comparison. The next word is usually a noun phrase that is expected to follow.

modes.label: "the" after "and" in titles
modes.description: The word "the" after a name plus "and" in book or band titles.
modes.example: Larry Raspberry and<< the>> High Steppers.

modes.label: "and" after "the patient"
modes.description: The word "and" joining "the patient" to a following noun in label warnings.
modes.example: requires reevaluation of the patient<< and>> treatment regimen

modes.label: Pronoun or preposition completing a phrase
modes.description: A pronoun or "in" that closes a verb or adjective phrase and leads into a possessive or noun.
modes.example: did not let the child express<< himself>> or herself.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like "the" or "and" where a noun phrase is about to follow.
